messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PD page fired for service: inference-prod - urgency: high - incident: INC-4821 - link: https://pd.example/INC-4821
Samir Iqbal: I saw the PD alert flood. any idea who got paged? looks like contractors started getting pages.
Maya Chen: Confirming, our monitoring shows a spike in latency for /v1/generate around 02:14 UTC. PD says "oncall@contractors" acknowledged.
Irene (oncall): wait what — i'm on primary for inference-prod right now, i didn't get a page. can someone paste the pd escalation log?
PagerDuty Bot: ESCALATION LOG: initial trigger -> service: inference-prod -> schedule: inference-prod-rotation -> target: inference-prod-oncall -> routed to: inference-shadows (contractors) due to schedule transfer id=sch-sync-2026-03-15
Liam Ortiz: ugh looks like the schedule sync job ran and applied a shadow schedule override. OncallSchedulerBot, did the nightly sync run?
OncallSchedulerBot: nightly-sync job completed (02:00 UTC). diffs: 1 schedule updated (inference-prod) - reason: shadow-sync-fix. job_id=ns-2026-0315-7
Samir Iqbal: that matches. the job included a stale shadow entry that binds the contractors rota to the prod service for midnight hours. see snippet:```yaml
schedule: inference-prod
overrides:
  - start: 00:00
    end: 04:00
    target: contractors-night-shadow
    source: legacy-sync
```
Maya Chen: so PD properly routed to the schedule the control plane handed to it. two immediate things: stop pages to contractors, and notify customers if there's user-facing degradation. Nina - Support, any customer reports?
Nina - Support: we've got 5 customer tickets about elevated latency and 2 chat pings in #support-urgent. customers noticing timeouts on batch requests. escalated to enterprise CSMs.
Irene (oncall): i'm going to manually re-route PD to the correct oncall and silence the contractor schedule. Samir, can you patch the scheduler to rollback the override?
Samir Iqbal: on it — rolling back the single override now. ```bash
# rollback
curl -X POST https://schedules.api/rollback -d '{"job_id":"ns-2026-0315-7","schedules":["inference-prod"]}'
```
Samir Iqbal: rollback accepted, PD schedule should update in ~20s. triggering manual reroute:```bash
pdctl reroute --service inference-prod --to inference-prod-oncall --force
```
PagerDuty Bot: REROUTE: request accepted. new target: inference-prod-oncall. previous escalations remain, silencing contractor targets for 30m.
Irene (oncall): acked the remaining PD alerts and started the mitigation runbook. copying key steps: 1) scale up gpu pool, 2) enable degraded-mode cache, 3) notify clients. executing step 1.
Platform-SRE: scaling up +warmup — adding 2 nodes to dedicated pool; ETA 90s.
Maya Chen: enabling degraded-mode cache now (prefix caching). this should cut tail latency.
Nina - Support: posting message to affected customers now: "We're investigating elevated latency; engineers are on it; we'll update in 20m."
Samir Iqbal: verify PD ack state: contractors had 3 acks, i forced auto-resolve on their stale incidents to avoid further paging. pdctl note added: "stale shadow schedule caused misroute; resolved by rollback"
Irene (oncall): confirmed no new pages after reroute. customers seeing slight improvement but still elevated. keeping paging to oncall only.
Liam Ortiz: logging for RCA: scheduler nightly-sync accepted a legacy override because it didn't validate target whitelist. need to add a guard to prevent non-approved targets in prod schedules. filing ticket now.
Samir Iqbal: ticket created: INFRA-1242 "scheduler: validate schedule overrides against approved targets" — assigned to eng-infra.
Maya Chen: quick postmortem notes for timeline: trigger 02:14 UTC -> pages to contractors 02:14-02:18 -> rollback and reroute 02:16 -> mitigation scale & cache 02:18 -> partial recovery 02:25 -> follow-up monitoring.
Nina - Support: customers updated at 02:20 UTC. one customer requested SLA credit, flagged to CSMs.
Irene (oncall): thanks team. postmortem owners: Samir + Liam. action items in INFRA-1242 and add PD playbook step for "verify target list before schedule sync".
Samir Iqbal: adding owners and timeline to the incident ticket. will also scrub logs to ensure no sensitive contractor messages went out.
PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT INC-4821 status: resolved (manual resolve) - root cause: scheduler shadow-override applied to prod schedule -> misroute. followups: INFRA-1242, add-playbook-check, customer-sla-review.
Maya Chen: adding note: consider adding a fail-open that keeps pages to primary if schedule sync fails validation.
Irene (oncall): i'll write a short incident summary for the docs and mention customer impact class: P2 (degraded service, multiple customers affected). closing thread in 1h once post-incident tasks created. :white_check_mark:
